movelist.name: Feint
movelist.effect: If a foe uses a Move with the Shield Keyword in response to one of your actions, you may activate Feint to cause the triggering Move to Fail. Feint is activated as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Brick Break
movelist.effect: Light Screen and Reflect may not be activated in response to Brick Break.

movelist.name: Jump Kick
movelist.effect: If Jump Kick misses, the user loses Hit Points equal to 1/4th of their Max Hit Points. A failure to hit due to a Move with the Shield keyword does not count as a miss. This Move cannot be used if Gravity is in effect.

movelist.name: Rolling Kick
movelist.effect: Rolling Kick Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Meditate
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.effect: Increases the Damage Base of Moves with the Exhaust, Recoil, or Reckless Keywords by +3. Reckless Moves: Jump Kick, Hi Jump Kick, Close Combat, Draco Meteor, Hammer Arm, Leaf Storm, Outrage, Overheat, Petal Dance, Psycho Boost, Superpower, Thrash, and V-Create.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Paralysis. Defensive.
